# TechTide Corporate LLP FAQ

## What does TechTide do?

TechTide develops custom software, web applications, mobile applications, SaaS products, automation systems, and AI-powered solutions.

## Does TechTide build SaaS products?

Yes. TechTide provides end-to-end SaaS product development including MVP creation, architecture, development, deployment, and maintenance.

## Does TechTide develop mobile apps?

Yes. TechTide develops Android, iOS, Flutter, and React Native applications.

## Does TechTide provide AI solutions?

Yes. TechTide offers AI integrations, AI-powered automation, chatbots, and intelligent business applications.

## What technologies does TechTide use?

React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Flutter, React Native, AWS, Docker, Firebase, and OpenAI APIs.

## Who are TechTide's ideal clients?

Startups, SaaS founders, SMEs, enterprises, and organizations seeking digital transformation.

## Does TechTide offer long-term support?

Yes. TechTide provides maintenance, optimization, updates, and ongoing technical support.
